fieldData.excerpt: This guide details how to participate in the Radix Rewards Public Test, and the good news is you can already start linking your accounts, ready for July 7th!
fieldData.main-content:
The Radix Rewards Public Test starts July 7 at 00:00 UTC and runs until July 13 at 23:59 UTC. This is a full back-end rehearsal for the MVP points-based airdrop system. While Season Points (SP) won’t carry over to Season 1, participants will earn bonus rewards for helping test the system.

This guide details how to participate, and the good news is you can already start linking your accounts ready for July 7th using the steps below!

Here’s how to participate in the testing:

Step 1: Enroll and Connect Your Wallet

  • Go to the Radix Rewards test site (https://incentives-preview.radixdlt.com/) on either desktop or mobile.
  • Click “Enroll in Campaign” or “Open app” in the top right.
  • Click “Accounts” on the left menu bar.
  • Open your Radix Wallet mobile app and follow the instructions to:
    • Connect a Persona (may be visible on the leaderboard).
    • Connect one or more accounts (you can connect multiple; points will be pooled, Radix Rewards doesn’t put anything on ledger or public showing a link between accounts).
  • You must have at least $50 of XRD across your linked accounts to earn rewards.

Step 2 (optional): Link Additional Accounts

  1. Click “Connect New Account.” on https://incentives-preview.radixdlt.com/dashboard/accounts
  2. In your Radix Wallet app, select the accounts you want to link.
  3. Sign the verification message.
  4. Linked accounts will show up in your dashboard.

Accounts can only be connected once and cannot be removed later. Multiple account links are stored off-ledger and are not visible on-chain.

Step 3: Start Using DeFi

Once your accounts are linked, you’ll automatically start earning Activity Points (AP) for eligible on-chain activity, as long as the total XRD/LSUs on all linked accounts is more than $50, including XRD/LSU in supported pools, lending etc. 

During the public test, points will be tracked for the following activities:

On Ociswap, CaviarNine, and DeFiPlaza, you can:

  • Add liquidity or trade in the following pools:
    • xUSDC:XRD
    • xUSDT:XRD
    • xETH:XRD
    • xWBTC:XRD
  • And additionally on CaviarNine, you can add liquidity to LSULP or Hyperstaking.

‍

On WEFT Finance and Root Finance you can:

  • Supply (lend) in the following assets:
    • xUSDC
    • xUSDT
    • xETH
    • xWBTC
    • XRD
    • LSULP (on Root only)

‍

Anywhere on the Radix mainnet you can also earn activity points from:

  • Paying network transaction fees
  • Interacting with components (unique component interactions per week)

‍

For the XRD Multiplier, you can:

  • Hold or deposit the following assets:
    • XRD
    • LSU
    • LSULP
    • Deposit any of the above in the above supported pools/applications

‍

Activity Points are converted into Season Points using percentile rankings and multiplier logic based on your XRD/LSU holdings. The more you genuinely participate, the more you earn. We will be releasing more details on the calculation system and multiplier system after the test. 

Please remember that activity and season points earned during the test will be wiped.

Why Participate?

This test ensures the full backend rewards engine works as intended before Season 1 launches. You’ll help validate fairness, anti-farming protections, and reward logic while earning a Season 1 bonus for participating.

Start preparing now. The test goes live July 7.

Important note: While this is a test run, it is highly likely that malicious actors may attempt to use this test and the Radix Rewards program to direct you to phishing sites or similar. You should never share your seedphrase with anyone, and when looking for the Radix Rewards, always ensure it’s from official channels. Support will never be given via DMs.
